summary_ja: 一定の要件を満たす金融業務を営む関連会社等について、少数出資の調整や自己保有調整の代わりに比例連結方式で連結自己資本規制比率を算出することを認め、一度採用したら原則継続する旨を定める条文。
summary_en: Permits proportional consolidation of affiliated companies engaged in financial business that meet specified joint-control requirements as an alternative to minority-investment and self-holding deductions, and requires continued use once adopted.
